keyPhrases.text: three hours of peaty blarney troweled up
why does the final harvest feel so scant?
I'm as shocked as you are
I ought to adore this play
Sam Mendes' firm, generous direction and a spirited cast keep each scene crackling
surprisingly slender for such an over-populated work

reasoning: Despite some praise for direction and cast energy, the review is fundamentally disappointed. The critic expresses shock at not liking a highly acclaimed play they expected to 'adore.' Key criticisms include excessive length, overabundance without substance, and a thin plot. The damning-with-faint-praise line 'Well, I wasn't bored' signals a 2-star review.
